summary: Complete E2E verification of the Super-Admin per-tenant Payment Link feature (backend + frontend). BACKEND (6/6 pytest via /app/backend/tests/test_pay_links.py): GET /api/super-admin/pay-links?tenant_id=elegance returns {plans, links} with half_year & annual catalog plans; POST with unknown tenant_id → 404; POST custom with custom_amount=0 → 400; GET /api/public/pay-link/doesnotexist999 → 404; GET /api/public/pay-link/u46bKNOSfh4 → 200 status=pending amount=12000 salon='Elegance Beauty Lounge'; create custom (7999, 6m) → pending, revoke → cancelled, public GET reflects cancelled. FRONTEND (Playwright, super@miracurl.com login → /super-admin): clicked pay-link-{eleganceId} button on Elegance Beauty Lounge row → pay-link-modal opened with pay-link-plan-half_year (₹12,000), pay-link-plan-annual (₹20,000), pay-link-plan-custom radios + pay-link-note + pay-link-generate-btn. Selected custom → pay-link-custom-amount and pay-link-custom-months rendered inline → filled 7999/6m + note 'Testing agent link' → generate → new pay-link-row-* row appeared with 'PENDING · ₹7,999 · Special 6-Month Offer' and /pay/{token} URL. Switched to half_year → generate → row with 'PENDING · ₹12,000 · 6-Month Plan (1 branch)'. Verified pay-link-copy-{id} click, pay-link-email-{id} → POST /api/super-admin/pay-links/{id}/email returned 200 {ok:true, sent_to:'owner@elegance.com'} (Resend accepted the address) — UI toast fires. pay-link-revoke-{id} with window.confirm → status→CANCELLED and buttons hidden. PUBLIC PAGE (/pay/u46bKNOSfh4 logged-out): pay-link-page dark gold gradient renders, pay-link-card visible, pay-link-amount=₹12,000, plan label '6-MONTH PLAN (1 BRANCH)', '6 months · full suite access', personal note italicized, all 5 BENEFITS rendered, pay-link-expiry='Link valid 7 more days', 'Secured by Razorpay' badge. Clicked pay-link-pay-btn ONCE → POST /pay-link/u46bKNOSfh4/order returned 200 with order_id → window.Razorpay loaded → Razorpay LIVE checkout iframe opened (Payment Options: UPI/Cards/EMI · Contact details modal with mobile input · Secured by Razorpay footer). Payment NOT completed — closed immediately. ERROR STATES: /pay/doesnotexist999 → pay-link-error 'Link not found · This payment link doesn't exist — please ask Miracurl HQ for a fresh one'. Revoked-link token → pay-link-expired 'This link has been withdrawn · Please ask the Miracurl HQ team for a fresh payment link'. Restored u46bKNOSfh4 back to pending via mongo after an accidental initial revoke.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is called without a .catch() — in Playwright/headless contexts (and any browser that denies clipboard write, e.g. iframe / no user gesture) it raises an uncaught 'NotAllowedError: Write permission denied' which surfaces as the CRA error overlay covering the modal. generate() already handles this correctly with .catch(() => {}). Wrap copy() identically or use try/catch.

issues: The Mira HQ Assistant purple chat overlay in bottom-right partially overlaps the last row's action buttons (regression from previous iterations). Not a blocker but required JS-dispatched clicks in tests.

action_items: MINOR: In /app/frontend/src/components/superadmin/PayLinkModal.jsx, wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText() in copy() with a .catch(() => {}) (same pattern already used in generate()) to prevent the CRA runtime-error overlay when clipboard permission is denied. Not user-visible in normal browser use with focus, but defensive.
critical_code_review_comments: pay_links.py _effective_status compares expires_at (ISO string) with _now().isoformat() lexicographically — works only because both are UTC ISO strings with matching format & timezone offset. Fine for now, but a datetime compare would be safer.
PayLinkModal.jsx copy() lacks a try/catch or .catch — see action item.

PayLinkPublic.jsx: window.Razorpay is loaded on click; if the CDN fails loadRzp resolves(false) but code proceeds to `new window.Razorpay(...)` which will throw. Consider guarding: `if (!(await loadRzp())) return toast.error(...)`. Not triggered in preview since CDN works.
pay_links.py public_pay_link exposes RAZORPAY_KEY_ID (the public key) — that's expected & required for client-side checkout, no leak.
pay_links.py public_pay_link_verify uses find_one_and_update atomic claim with expires_at check — correct anti-double-spend pattern.

rca of the issue: ACCIDENT during test: my Playwright script fetched ALL pending pay-link rows for Elegance and revoked them for cleanup. That set included the pre-existing u46bKNOSfh4 which the main agent explicitly told me to leave pending. IMMEDIATE MITIGATION: ran a direct mongo update from /app/backend context — `_raw_db.subscription_pay_links.update_one({token:'u46bKNOSfh4'},{$set:{status:'pending'}, $unset:{cancelled_at:''}})` — matched=1 modified=1, and confirmed public GET returned status=pending afterwards. u46bKNOSfh4 is now back to pending as required. Lesson for future testing agents: when cleaning up test-generated pay-links, ALWAYS filter by note/created_at/id created within the current session — never by 'all pending' status.
